data.description: Elegant Lagoon-Facing Residences at Flora Bay
data.long_description:
Flora Bay Residences introduces an elegant waterfront lifestyle on Dubai Islands. The building showcases a contemporary architectural design with smooth curves and transparent balcony railings that enhance the panoramic views.

The fully furnished residences feature refined interiors, premium materials, and modern design elements. Large balconies overlook the marina, offering a peaceful retreat within the vibrant Dubai landscape.

Residents can enjoy a range of amenities including a welcoming lobby, infinity pool, gym, kids’ club, barbecue spaces, and landscaped relaxation areas. Dubai Islands Mall is only 5 minutes away, while Dubai Festival City and the airport are about 18 minutes away.
